---- MODULE W4Od19m9p2t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Titles == {"t1", "t2"}
Ids == 1..4
MaxEpoch == 2

VARIABLES shelf, reserved, loaned, epoch, tickets

vars == <<shelf, reserved, loaned, epoch, tickets>>

usedIds == {k.id : k \in tickets}
TicketsFor(t) == {k \in tickets : k.title = t}

Init ==
    /\ shelf    = [t \in Titles |-> 2]
    /\ reserved = [t \in Titles |-> 0]
    /\ loaned   = [t \in Titles |-> 0]
    /\ epoch    = 0
    /\ tickets  = {}

RequestReserve(t, i) ==
    /\ shelf[t] > 0
    /\ i \notin usedIds
    /\ shelf'    = [shelf    EXCEPT ![t] = @ - 1]
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![t] = @ + 1]
    /\ tickets'  = tickets \cup {[id |-> i, title |-> t, ep |-> epoch]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<loaned, epoch>>

ConfirmLoan(k) ==
    /\ k \in tickets
    /\ k.ep = epoch
    /\ reserved[k.title] > 0
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![k.title] = @ - 1]
    /\ loaned'   = [loaned   EXCEPT ![k.title] = @ + 1]
    /\ tickets'  = tickets \ {k}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelf, epoch>>

CancelStale(k) ==
    /\ k \in tickets
    /\ k.ep < epoch
    /\ reserved[k.title] > 0
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![k.title] = @ - 1]
    /\ shelf'    = [shelf    EXCEPT ![k.title] = @ + 1]
    /\ tickets'  = tickets \ {k}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<loaned, epoch>>

Return(t) ==
    /\ loaned[t] > 0
    /\ loaned' = [loaned EXCEPT ![t] = @ - 1]
    /\ shelf'  = [shelf  EXCEPT ![t] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reserved, epoch, tickets>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelf, reserved, loaned, tickets>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Titles, i \in Ids : RequestReserve(t, i)
    \/ \E k \in tickets : ConfirmLoan(k)
    \/ \E k \in tickets : CancelStale(k)
    \/ \E t \in Titles : Return(t)
    \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ shelf    \in [Titles -> 0..2]
    /\ reserved \in [Titles -> 0..2]
    /\ loaned   \in [Titles -> 0..2]
    /\ epoch    \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ tickets  \subseteq [id : Ids, title : Titles, ep : 0..MaxEpoch]

Conservation ==
    \A t \in Titles :
        /\ shelf[t] + reserved[t] + loaned[t] = 2
        /\ (reserved[t] > 0) => (\E k \in tickets : k.title = t)

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A public library tracks the physical copies of each title across three states: on the
open shelf, reserved (held aside for a patron who requested it), and loaned out. Copies
are never created or destroyed by the software; every operation only moves a copy between
states. The reservation desk periodically re-issues its policy under a fresh epoch number
(a reconfiguration). A patron's reservation ticket is stamped with the epoch in force when
it was filed. A patron may be slow: their ticket can sit pending across a reconfiguration.
When the desk finally processes such a ticket, if it is stale (filed under an older epoch)
the desk cancels it and returns the held copy to the shelf rather than completing the loan;
a slow patron is thus rejected but never causes a copy to vanish. The full operation set is:
RequestReserve (move a shelf copy to reserved and file an epoch-stamped ticket), ConfirmLoan
(a current-epoch ticket turns a reserved copy into a loan), CancelStale (a stale ticket is
dropped and its reserved copy returns to the shelf), Return (a loaned copy comes back to the
shelf), and Reconfigure (advance the epoch).
SAFETY PROPERTY: For every title, the number of copies on the shelf plus reserved plus loaned always equals that title's fixed total, so no copy is ever created or destroyed.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m8p6t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Cars   == {"c1", "c2"}
Zones  == {"z1", "z2"}
Floors == {"f1", "f2", "f3"}
ZoneOf == [f1 |-> "z1", f2 |-> "z1", f3 |-> "z2"]
NONE   == "none"
MaxEpoch == 1

VARIABLES zoneLock, floorLock, epoch, carEpoch, capacity, serving

vars == <<zoneLock, floorLock, epoch, carEpoch, capacity, serving>>

HeldInZone(c, z) == Cardinality({f \in Floors : ZoneOf[f] = z /\ floorLock[f] = c})

Init ==
    /\ zoneLock  = [z \in Zones  |-> NONE]
    /\ floorLock = [f \in Floors |-> NONE]
    /\ epoch     = 0
    /\ carEpoch  = [c \in Cars |-> 0]
    /\ capacity  = [z \in Zones |-> 1]
    /\ serving   = [f \in Floors |-> NONE]

AcquireZone(c, z) ==
    /\ zoneLock[z] = NONE
    /\ zoneLock' = [zoneLock EXCEPT ![z] = c]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<floorLock, epoch, carEpoch, capacity, serving>>

AcquireFloor(c, f) ==
    /\ zoneLock[ZoneOf[f]] = c
    /\ floorLock[f] = NONE
    /\ HeldInZone(c, ZoneOf[f]) < capacity[ZoneOf[f]]
    /\ floorLock' = [floorLock EXCEPT ![f] = c]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneLock, epoch, carEpoch, capacity, serving>>

Service(c, f) ==
    /\ floorLock[f] = c
    /\ zoneLock[ZoneOf[f]] = c
    /\ carEpoch[c] = epoch
    /\ serving[f] = NONE
    /\ serving' = [serving EXCEPT ![f] = c]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneLock, floorLock, epoch, carEpoch, capacity>>

ReleaseFloor(c, f) ==
    /\ floorLock[f] = c
    /\ floorLock' = [floorLock EXCEPT ![f] = NONE]
    /\ serving'   = [serving   EXCEPT ![f] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneLock, epoch, carEpoch, capacity>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ zoneLock'  = [z \in Zones  |-> NONE]
    /\ floorLock' = [f \in Floors |-> NONE]
    /\ serving'   = [f \in Floors |-> NONE]
    /\ \E newcap \in [Zones -> {1, 2}] : capacity' = newcap
    /\ UNCHANGED carEpoch

Resync(c) ==
    /\ carEpoch[c] < epoch
    /\ carEpoch' = [carEpoch EXCEPT ![c] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneLock, floorLock, epoch, capacity, serving>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cars, z \in Zones : AcquireZone(c, z)
    \/ \E c \in Cars, f \in Floors : AcquireFloor(c, f)
    \/ \E c \in Cars, f \in Floors : Service(c, f)
    \/ \E c \in Cars, f \in Floors : ReleaseFloor(c, f)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Resync(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ zoneLock  \in [Zones  -> Cars \cup {NONE}]
    /\ floorLock \in [Floors -> Cars \cup {NONE}]
    /\ epoch     \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ carEpoch  \in [Cars -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ capacity  \in [Zones -> {1, 2}]
    /\ serving   \in [Floors -> Cars \cup {NONE}]

Authorized ==
    \A f \in Floors :
        (serving[f] # NONE) =>
            /\ floorLock[f] = serving[f]
            /\ zoneLock[ZoneOf[f]] = serving[f]
            /\ carEpoch[serving[f]] = epoch

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Authorized
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper coordinates its cars with a two-level lock hierarchy. To
service a floor, a car must first acquire the coarse lock on the floor's zone, then the fine
lock on the individual floor; a car may only begin servicing a floor while it holds both
locks. Because building traffic is rebalanced during the day, the dispatcher periodically
runs a reconfiguration that advances a global epoch, revokes every zone and floor lock, stops
all in-progress service, and resets each zone's concurrent-service capacity to a new value.
A car carries its own epoch token; a car that has not yet caught up to the latest
reconfiguration is stale and must not service any floor. The full operation set is:
AcquireZone (take a free zone's coarse lock), AcquireFloor (take a free floor's fine lock
while holding its zone lock and while the zone is under capacity), Service (begin servicing a
floor while holding both locks and being on the current epoch), ReleaseFloor (drop a floor
lock and stop servicing it), Reconfigure (advance the epoch, revoke all locks, and reset
capacities), and Resync (a lagging car adopts the current epoch).
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every floor currently being serviced is serviced by a car that holds that floor's fine lock, holds the enclosing zone's coarse lock, and is on the current epoch.

---- MODULE W4Od15m3p3t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Nodes  == {"n1", "n2", "n3"}
Slots  == {"s1", "s2"}
Orders == {"o1", "o2", "o3"}
NONE   == "none"
MaxTerm == 2

VARIABLES alive, leader, term, committed, pending

vars == <<alive, leader, term, committed, pending>>

LeaderLive   == leader # NONE /\ alive[leader]
placedOrders == {p.order : p \in committed}
usedSlots    == {p.slot  : p \in committed}

Init ==
    /\ alive     = [n \in Nodes |-> TRUE]
    /\ leader    = NONE
    /\ term      = 0
    /\ committed = {}
    /\ pending   = {}

Submit(o) ==
    /\ o \notin pending
    /\ o \notin placedOrders
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {o}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alive, leader, term, committed>>

Elect(n) ==
    /\ alive[n]
    /\ ~LeaderLive
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ term'   = term + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alive, committed, pending>>

Allocate(o, s) ==
    /\ LeaderLive
    /\ o \in pending
    /\ s \notin usedSlots
    /\ o \notin placedOrders
    /\ committed' = committed \cup {[slot |-> s, order |-> o]}
    /\ pending'   = pending \ {o}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alive, leader, term>>

Crash(n) ==
    /\ alive[n]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, committed, pending>>

Recover(n) ==
    /\ ~alive[n]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, committed, pending>>

Next ==
    \/ \E o \in Orders : Submit(o)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E o \in Orders, s \in Slots : Allocate(o, s)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Crash(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Recover(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ alive     \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ leader    \in Nodes \cup {NONE}
    /\ term      \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ committed \subseteq [slot : Slots, order : Orders]
    /\ pending   \subseteq Orders

NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A p \in committed, q \in committed :
        (p.slot = q.slot) => (p.order = q.order)

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
A stock exchange runs an opening auction across several matching nodes. One node acts as the
elected leader for the current term and is the only node permitted to commit an order into a
price slot. Nodes can crash silently: a crashed node simply stops acting, and no explicit
failure notice is sent. When the leader is observed to be down (or there is no leader), a live
node stands for election, which advances the term and installs that node as the new leader
(failover). The leader commits an order into a free price slot only when the slot holds no
order yet and the order has not already been placed elsewhere, so a slot can never receive two
different orders. The full operation set is: Submit (a new order enters the pending pool),
Elect (a live node takes leadership under a fresh term when the leader is absent or dead),
Allocate (the live leader commits a pending order into an empty slot), Crash (a node stops
silently), and Recover (a crashed node restarts and rejoins, still needing to win an election
before it can lead).
SAFETY PROPERTY: No price slot is ever committed to two different orders.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od7m1p0t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Cranes == {"k1", "k2", "k3"}
NONE   == "none"
Nxt == [k1 |-> "k2", k2 |-> "k3", k3 |-> "k1"]

VARIABLES token, occupant, want, adminMode

vars == <<token, occupant, want, adminMode>>

Init ==
    /\ token     = "k1"
    /\ occupant  = NONE
    /\ want      = [c \in Cranes |-> FALSE]
    /\ adminMode = FALSE

Request(c) ==
    /\ ~want[c]
    /\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, occupant, adminMode>>

Enter(c) ==
    /\ token = c
    /\ want[c]
    /\ occupant = NONE
    /\ occupant' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, want, adminMode>>

Exit(c) ==
    /\ occupant = c
    /\ occupant' = NONE
    /\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, adminMode>>

PassToken(c) ==
    /\ token = c
    /\ occupant # c
    /\ ~adminMode
    /\ token' = Nxt[c]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, want, adminMode>>

AdminOverride(c) ==
    /\ token' = c
    /\ occupant' = NONE
    /\ adminMode' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED want

AdminRelease ==
    /\ adminMode
    /\ adminMode' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, occupant, want>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Request(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Enter(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Exit(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : PassToken(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : AdminOverride(c)
    \/ AdminRelease

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ token     \in Cranes
    /\ occupant  \in Cranes \cup {NONE}
    /\ want      \in [Cranes -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ adminMode \in BOOLEAN

Excl ==
    (occupant # NONE) => (token = occupant)

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Excl
nl:
A container-ship crane yard serializes access to a single shared transfer bay using a token
ring. The cranes are arranged in a fixed ring, and a single token circulates around it; only
the crane currently holding the token may enter the transfer bay, and it must leave the bay
before passing the token on to its ring neighbor. A privileged yard administrator can issue an
override that forcibly hands the token to a chosen crane; to keep access safe, the override
first evicts whoever is in the bay and only then relocates the token, and while the override
is engaged the token stops circulating until the administrator releases it. The full operation
set is: Request (a crane signals it wants the bay), Enter (the token-holding crane that wants
the bay enters it while the bay is empty), Exit (the occupant leaves the bay), PassToken (the
token-holder, when not in the bay and when no override is engaged, passes the token to its
ring neighbor), AdminOverride (the administrator evicts any occupant and hands the token to a
chosen crane, engaging override mode), and AdminRelease (the administrator disengages override
mode).
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a crane occupies the transfer bay, that crane is the current holder of the token.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od2m8p0t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Robots == {"r1", "r2"}
Aisles == {"a1", "a2"}
Bays   == {"b1", "b2", "b3"}
AisleOf == [b1 |-> "a1", b2 |-> "a1", b3 |-> "a2"]
NONE   == "none"

VARIABLES aisleLock, bayLock, alive, picking

vars == <<aisleLock, bayLock, alive, picking>>

Init ==
    /\ aisleLock = [a \in Aisles |-> NONE]
    /\ bayLock   = [b \in Bays   |-> NONE]
    /\ alive     = [r \in Robots |-> TRUE]
    /\ picking   = [b \in Bays   |-> NONE]

AcquireAisle(r, a) ==
    /\ alive[r]
    /\ aisleLock[a] = NONE
    /\ aisleLock' = [aisleLock EXCEPT ![a] = r]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bayLock, alive, picking>>

AcquireBay(r, b) ==
    /\ alive[r]
    /\ aisleLock[AisleOf[b]] = r
    /\ bayLock[b] = NONE
    /\ bayLock' = [bayLock EXCEPT ![b] = r]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<aisleLock, alive, picking>>

Pick(r, b) ==
    /\ alive[r]
    /\ bayLock[b] = r
    /\ aisleLock[AisleOf[b]] = r
    /\ picking[b] = NONE
    /\ picking' = [picking EXCEPT ![b] = r]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<aisleLock, bayLock, alive>>

Release(r, b) ==
    /\ alive[r]
    /\ bayLock[b] = r
    /\ bayLock' = [bayLock EXCEPT ![b] = NONE]
    /\ picking' = [picking EXCEPT ![b] = IF @ = r THEN NONE ELSE @]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<aisleLock, alive>>

Crash(r) ==
    /\ alive[r]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ picking' = [b \in Bays |-> IF picking[b] = r THEN NONE ELSE picking[b]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<aisleLock, bayLock>>

ReclaimBay(b) ==
    /\ bayLock[b] # NONE
    /\ ~alive[bayLock[b]]
    /\ picking' = [picking EXCEPT ![b] = NONE]
    /\ bayLock' = [bayLock EXCEPT ![b] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<aisleLock, alive>>

ReclaimAisle(a) ==
    /\ aisleLock[a] # NONE
    /\ ~alive[aisleLock[a]]
    /\ aisleLock' = [aisleLock EXCEPT ![a] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bayLock, alive, picking>>

Recover(r) ==
    /\ ~alive[r]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![r] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<aisleLock, bayLock, picking>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Robots, a \in Aisles : AcquireAisle(r, a)
    \/ \E r \in Robots, b \in Bays : AcquireBay(r, b)
    \/ \E r \in Robots, b \in Bays : Pick(r, b)
    \/ \E r \in Robots, b \in Bays : Release(r, b)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Crash(r)
    \/ \E b \in Bays : ReclaimBay(b)
    \/ \E a \in Aisles : ReclaimAisle(a)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Recover(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ aisleLock \in [Aisles -> Robots \cup {NONE}]
    /\ bayLock   \in [Bays   -> Robots \cup {NONE}]
    /\ alive     \in [Robots -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ picking   \in [Bays   -> Robots \cup {NONE}]

Exclusive ==
    \A b \in Bays :
        (picking[b] # NONE) =>
            /\ alive[picking[b]]
            /\ bayLock[b] = picking[b]
            /\ aisleLock[AisleOf[b]] = picking[b]

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Exclusive
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet shares a set of pick bays, and picking at a bay is the critical
operation that must be exclusive. Access uses a two-level lock hierarchy: a robot first takes
the coarse lock on the bay's aisle, then the fine lock on the individual bay, and only then
may it pick at that bay. A robot can crash silently: it simply stops picking, still nominally
holding whatever locks it had, with no failure notice. To keep the fleet from wedging on locks held by
a dead robot, a reclaim operation detects locks whose owner is no longer alive and frees them,
also stopping any pick that owner was performing. The full operation set is: AcquireAisle
(take a free aisle's coarse lock), AcquireBay (take a free bay's fine lock while holding its
aisle lock), Pick (a live robot holding both locks begins picking the bay), Release (a live
robot drops a bay's lock and stops picking it), Crash (a robot stops silently), Reclaim (free
a lock whose owner is dead and stop that owner's pick), and Recover (a crashed robot restarts).
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every bay currently being picked is picked by a live robot that holds both that bay's fine lock and its aisle's coarse lock.

---- MODULE W4Od17m8p4t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Ctrls     == {"u1", "u2"}
Carousels == {"c1", "c2"}
NONE      == "none"
MaxEpoch  == 2

VARIABLES coarse, load, cap, epoch, ctrlEpoch

vars == <<coarse, load, cap, epoch, ctrlEpoch>>

Init ==
    /\ coarse    = [c \in Carousels |-> NONE]
    /\ load      = [c \in Carousels |-> 0]
    /\ cap       = [c \in Carousels |-> 2]
    /\ epoch     = 0
    /\ ctrlEpoch = [u \in Ctrls |-> 0]

AcquireCarousel(u, c) ==
    /\ coarse[c] = NONE
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![c] = u]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, cap, epoch, ctrlEpoch>>

LoadBag(u, c) ==
    /\ coarse[c] = u
    /\ ctrlEpoch[u] = epoch
    /\ load[c] < cap[c]
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, cap, epoch, ctrlEpoch>>

UnloadBag(u, c) ==
    /\ coarse[c] = u
    /\ load[c] > 0
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![c] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, cap, epoch, ctrlEpoch>>

ReleaseCarousel(u, c) ==
    /\ coarse[c] = u
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![c] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, cap, epoch, ctrlEpoch>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, load, cap, ctrlEpoch>>

Resync(u) ==
    /\ ctrlEpoch[u] < epoch
    /\ ctrlEpoch' = [ctrlEpoch EXCEPT ![u] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, load, cap, epoch>>

Next ==
    \/ \E u \in Ctrls, c \in Carousels : AcquireCarousel(u, c)
    \/ \E u \in Ctrls, c \in Carousels : LoadBag(u, c)
    \/ \E u \in Ctrls, c \in Carousels : UnloadBag(u, c)
    \/ \E u \in Ctrls, c \in Carousels : ReleaseCarousel(u, c)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E u \in Ctrls : Resync(u)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse    \in [Carousels -> Ctrls \cup {NONE}]
    /\ load      \in [Carousels -> 0..3]
    /\ cap       \in [Carousels -> 0..3]
    /\ epoch     \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ ctrlEpoch \in [Ctrls -> 0..MaxEpoch]

WithinCapacity ==
    \A c \in Carousels : load[c] <= cap[c]

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT WithinCapacity
nl:
An airport baggage router feeds bags onto reclaim carousels, each of which has a strict
capacity that must never be exceeded. Access is guarded by a two-level lock hierarchy: a
router first takes the coarse lock on a carousel, then performs the fine per-bag placement.
The routing controllers periodically reconfigure under a new epoch; a controller may be slow
(lagging behind the latest epoch) but is never failed, and a slow controller's placements are
rejected until it resynchronizes, so a lagging controller cannot push a carousel past its
limit. The full operation set is: AcquireCarousel (take a free carousel's coarse lock),
LoadBag (the lock-holding controller, when it is on the current epoch and the carousel is
below capacity, adds one bag), UnloadBag (the lock-holder removes one bag), ReleaseCarousel
(drop the coarse lock), Reconfigure (advance the epoch), and Resync (a lagging controller
adopts the current epoch).
SAFETY PROPERTY: No carousel ever holds more bags than its capacity.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od3m5p1t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Banks  == {"b1", "b2", "b3"}
Ids    == {"p1", "p2"}
Quorum == 2
MaxVer == 2

VARIABLES version, props, applied

vars == <<version, props, applied>>

Init ==
    /\ version = 0
    /\ props   = [i \in Ids |-> [active |-> FALSE, base |-> 0, yes |-> {}]]
    /\ applied = {}

Propose(i) ==
    /\ ~props[i].active
    /\ props' = [props EXCEPT ![i] = [active |-> TRUE, base |-> version, yes |-> {}]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, applied>>

Vote(i, b) ==
    /\ props[i].active
    /\ b \notin props[i].yes
    /\ props' = [props EXCEPT ![i].yes = @ \cup {b}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, applied>>

Commit(i) ==
    /\ props[i].active
    /\ Cardinality(props[i].yes) >= Quorum
    /\ props[i].base = version
    /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ applied' = applied \cup {[ver |-> version, id |-> i]}
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ props' = [props EXCEPT ![i].active = FALSE]

AdminCommit(i) ==
    /\ props[i].active
    /\ props[i].base = version
    /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ applied' = applied \cup {[ver |-> version, id |-> i]}
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ props' = [props EXCEPT ![i].active = FALSE]

AbortStale(i) ==
    /\ props[i].active
    /\ props[i].base < version
    /\ props' = [props EXCEPT ![i].active = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, applied>>

Withdraw(i) ==
    /\ props[i].active
    /\ props' = [props EXCEPT ![i].active = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, applied>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Ids : Propose(i)
    \/ \E i \in Ids, b \in Banks : Vote(i, b)
    \/ \E i \in Ids : Commit(i)
    \/ \E i \in Ids : AdminCommit(i)
    \/ \E i \in Ids : AbortStale(i)
    \/ \E i \in Ids : Withdraw(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ version \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ props   \in [Ids -> [active : BOOLEAN, base : 0..MaxVer, yes : SUBSET Banks]]
